blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-view anomaly detection is crucial for industrial inspection to identify defects hidden from single viewpoints. Yet, despite their strong success in single-view applications, reconstruction-based methods remain largely underexplored in multi-view settings. A key challenge in extending these methods lies in generating view-consistent pseudo-anomalies. To address this, we propose PAR, a reconstruction-based framework for enhanced multi-view anomaly detection. First, we introduce a feature perturbation strategy coupled with a consensus aggregation module that integrates these perturbed features across viewpoints to mitigate view-inconsistent anomalies and construct highly aligned pseudo-anomaly representations. Second, we employ a view-specialized multi-decoder architecture; by assigning a dedicated decoder to each view, we increase the model's representational complexity, enabling the generation of highly feasible, localized anomaly maps rather than less precise, view-agnostic reconstructions. Last, we incorporate Fourier attention into the decoders to emphasize global frequency-domain structures over local token evidence, effectively preventing identity mapping. Extensive experiments on the Real-IAD dataset demonstrate that PAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in sample-level, image-level, and pixel-level anomaly detection. Our code is available at https://github.com/SpatialAILab/PAR_mvad.
blocks.zh: 多视角异常检测对于工业检查发现从单一角度隐藏的缺陷至关重要。 然而,尽管在单一观点应用方面非常成功,但基于重建的方法在多观点环境中仍然在很大程度上没有得到充分利用。 推广这些方法的关键挑战在于产生与视野一致的伪神经病. 为了解决这一问题,我们提议建立基于重建的框架,加强多视图异常探测。 首先,我们采用了一个特征扰动战略,同时采用了一个共识汇总模块,将不同观点的这些扰动特征结合起来,以缓解视向不一致的异常现象并构建高度一致的伪异常表述。 其次,我们采用了一个有视野特色的多解码器架构;通过为每个视图分配一个专用解码器,我们增加了模型的代表性复杂性,使得能够生成高度可行,局部性的异常地图,而不是不太精确的,可视-不可知的重建. 最后,我们把Fourier的注意力纳入解码器中,强调全球频域结构而不是本地的标语证据,有效地防止了身份映射. 对Real-IAD数据集的广泛实验表明,PAR在样本级,图像级和像素级异常检测中,其性能始终高于最先进的方法. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/SPatialAILab/PAR_mvad上查阅。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Anomaly detection plays a crucial role in industrial inspection, where early defect discovery can reduce material waste, manual inspection costs, and production risk. Since anomalous samples in manufacturing are scarce and diverse, enumerating all possible defect patterns is impractical. Therefore, most visual anomaly detection methods adopt a one-class setting, training only on normal data to detect deviations at test time.
blocks.zh: 异常检测在工业检查中发挥着关键作用,早期发现缺陷可以减少物质浪费、人工检查成本和生产风险。 由于制造中的异常样品很少,而且种类繁多,列举所有可能的缺陷模式是不切实际的. 因此,大多数视觉异常探测方法都采用一等的设置,只就正常数据进行培训以检测测试时的偏差.

blocks.en: Despite their success, most conventional anomaly detection methods assume single-view images. This is restrictive in real-world inspection, as defect visibility heavily depends on object geometry and viewpoint. While defects on relatively flat objects (e.g., the PCB category in Real-IAD, Figure 6 ) may remain observable across multiple angles, defective regions on volumetric objects can easily become invisible from certain viewpoints. For example, a bird’s-eye view of a mint (Figure 1 ) cannot reliably capture side-region defects visible only obliquely. Moreover, multi-view anomaly detection must not only observe defects from multiple angles, but also reason about cross-view correlations and geometric inconsistencies. These limitations have sparked recent research in multi-view anomaly detection ( Wang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 尽管它们取得了成功,但大多数传统的异常探测方法都假设了单视图像. 这在现实世界的检查中是限制性的,因为缺陷的能见度在很大程度上取决于物体几何和观点. 虽然相对平坦的物体上的缺陷(例如,Real-IAD中的PCB类别,图6)可能仍然从多个角度观察到,但从某些角度看,体积物体上的缺陷区域很容易变得看不见。 例如,对一薄荷(图1)的鸟眼观光无法可靠地捕捉到仅可直观地观察到的侧面区域缺陷。 此外,多视异常检测不仅必须从多角度观察缺陷,还必须观察交叉视相关和几何不一致的原因. 这些限制引发了近期多景异常探测的研究(Wang等,2024.

blocks.en: Recent multi-view studies have mainly explored memory bank, teacher-student, and normalizing flow paradigms. For instance, MVAD uses a teacher-student framework for cross-view interactions ( He et al., 2026 ) , while Multi-Flow enables cross-view message passing within normalizing flows ( Kruse and Rosenhahn, 2025 ) . Nevertheless, to the best of our knowledge, no prior industrial multi-view method has systematically explored a reconstruction-based design. Given their strong performance in single-view settings (e.g., RealNet ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , Dinomaly ( Guo et al., 2025 ) ), extending reconstruction-based approaches to multi-view settings provides the primary motivation for our work.
blocks.zh: 最近的多景研究主要探索了记忆库,师生,使流派范式正常化. 例如,MVAD使用师生框架进行交叉视图互动(He等,2026年),而多福则可以使交叉视图信息在正常流内传递(Kruse和Rosenhahn,2025年)。 然而,据我们所知,没有一种以前的工业多观点方法系统地探索过基于重建的设计。 由于其在单景环境(如:RealNet(Zhang等,2024年),Dinomaly)中的强势表现. (Guo等,2025年)),将基于重建的方针推广到多景环境,为我们的工作提供了主要动力.

blocks.en: Devising a reconstruction-based multi-view approach, however, turns out to be non-trivial. A key bottleneck is generating view-consistent pseudo-anomalies during training. While local perturbations effectively prevent trivial identity mapping in single-view settings, applying them independently across multiple views fails to incorporate underlying geometric correlations, generating unaligned, isolated corruptions. This produces overly view-specific features that fail to reflect a coherent, shared anomalous pattern, significantly degrading multi-view anomaly detection performance.
blocks.zh: 然而,设计一种基于重建的多观点办法,结果证明是非三角性的。 一个关键的瓶颈就是在训练期间产生与取景一致的伪模拟. 虽然局部扰动有效地防止了在单一观点环境中的细微身份映射,但是在多种观点中独立应用它们却未能包含基本的几何相关性,产生不相通,孤立的腐败. 这产生了过度的取景特异性特征,无法反映连贯的,共享的异常模式,显著地贬低了多视图异常检测性能.

blocks.en: In this work, we address this challenge by proposing PAR (Perturb, Aggregate then Reconstruct), a novel reconstruction-based framework tailored for multi-view anomaly detection. Our pipeline begins by subjecting encoded multi-view features to a stochastic perturbation strategy, followed immediately by a late consensus aggregation module. This step acts as a latent-space consensus mechanism, directly mitigating spatial disjointedness to construct view-aligned pseudo-anomalies. These aligned representations are then routed into a view-specialized multi-decoder architecture. Rather than forcing a single shared decoder to generalize across all camera angles, assigning a dedicated reconstruction pathway to each view substantially increases the model’s representational complexity, yielding highly feasible, localized anomaly maps. Furthermore, we equip these decoders with Fourier attention to shift the reconstruction process from the spatial to the frequency domain. By forcing the network to recover global structural patterns instead of copying local token evidence, this mechanism prevents trivial identity mapping and ensures robust, anomaly-free recovery.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们通过提出PAR(Perturb,Aggregate后再重建)来应对这一挑战,这是一个基于重建的新框架,适合多视角异常检测. 我们的管道首先将编码的多视图特性置于一个有条理的扰动战略之下,然后立即建立一个晚共识汇总模块。 这一步骤起到了潜在的空间共识机制的作用,直接缓解了空间的不相通性,以构建视线相通的假神经. 这些对齐的表示然后被引导入一个视图专用多解码器架构. 而不是强迫一个共享的解码器将所有相机角度都概括起来,而是为每个视图指定一个专用的重建路径,大大增加了模型的代表性复杂性,产生了非常可行的局部异常地图。 此外,我们为这些解码器配备了Fourier的注意力来将重建过程从空间域转移到频率域. 这种机制迫使网络恢复全球结构模式,而不是复制当地标志性证据,从而防止了微不足道的身份映射,并确保强劲、无异常的恢复。

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows: • We propose PAR , a reconstruction-based framework for multi-view anomaly detection that follows the principle of perturb, aggregate, then reconstruct. • We introduce a composite feature perturbation strategy combined with consensus aggregation to construct better view-aligned pseudo-anomaly features. • We design a view-specialized multi-decoder architecture equipped with Fourier attention to reconstruct features based on global structural patterns, yielding more precise anomaly maps that lead to enhanced multi-view anomaly detection.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的主要贡献如下: 我们提出PAR, 即一个基于重建的多视图异常探测框架,遵循扰动、聚合、再重建的原则。 我们采用综合地貌扰动战略,再加上协商一致的汇总,以构建更好的视线相通的假异常地貌。 我们设计出一种能装备傅里叶注意力的取景专用多解码器建筑,以全球结构模式为基础来重建地物,产生更精确的异常地图,从而可以增强多视图异常探测.

The resulting features are then perturbed by the composite feature perturbation (CFP) module using feature jitter, masking, and dropout to generate anomaly-like corrupted features. These perturbed features are aggregated across views by the consensus aggregation module to construct more view-aligned pseudo-anomaly features. Finally, the aggregated features are fed into a set of view-specialized decoders, where each decoder is responsible for reconstructing the normal feature of a particular view. blocks.en: 2. Related work
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Unsupervised anomaly detection
blocks.zh: 2.1. 无监督地检测异常情况

blocks.en:
Unsupervised anomaly detection aims to identify anomalies using only normal data, making it particularly suitable for real-world industrial scenarios where anomalous samples are scarce and diverse. Since it is impractical to collect and annotate all possible defect types, learning solely from normal data provides a scalable and cost-effective solution.
Existing methods can be broadly categorized into representation-based and reconstruction-based approaches.
blocks.zh:
不受监督的异常检测旨在仅用正常数据来识别异常现象,使其特别适合异常样本稀少且多样的现实世界工业情景. 由于收集和说明所有可能的缺陷类型是不切实际的,仅从正常数据中学习就提供了一个可扩展和成本效益高的解决办法。
现有方法可大致分为基于代表性的方法和基于重建的方法。

blocks.en: Representation-based methods model the distribution of normal features in a representation space and detect anomalies by measuring feature deviations between normal and anomalous samples. PaDiM ( Defard et al., 2021 ) models patch-wise feature distributions with multivariate Gaussians, PatchCore ( Roth et al., 2022 ) constructs a memory bank of normal patch features for nearest-neighbor retrieval, and CFA ( Lee et al., 2022 ) improves localization by adapting target-oriented features with a scalable memory bank. Recent studies have further extended embedding-based approaches using normalizing flow frameworks, such as CFlow ( Gudovskiy et al., 2022 ) , which explicitly model the probability distribution of normal features to estimate anomaly likelihoods. In addition, recent representation-based approaches have explored diverse feature modeling and embedding strategies, including contrastive learning, prototypical learning, and hybrid reconstruction–embedding frameworks ( Li et al., 2021 ; Guo et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; You et al., 2022 ) . However, these methods are often sensitive to distribution shifts and may struggle to generalize under varying conditions. Although these methods achieve strong performance, they also predominantly assume single-view inputs and do not explicitly exploit complementary evidence distributed across multiple viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 以表示法为模型,通过测量正常和异常样本之间的特征偏差,对一个表示空间中的正常特征进行分布并检测出异常. PaDIM (Defard等, 2021年) 型号为多变量高斯语的补丁特性分布,PatchCore (Roth等, 2022年) 构筑了普通补丁特性的内存库,供相邻最近的检索,而CAF (Lee等, 2022年) 通过将面向目标的特性与可缩放的内存库相适应来改进本地化. 最近的研究进一步扩展了以嵌入为基础的方法,利用了常态化的流量框架,例如CFlow(Gudovskiy等,2022年),明确模拟了正常特征的概率分布来估计异常概率. 此外,最近基于代表性的办法探索了不同的特征模型和嵌入战略,包括对比性学习、典型学习和混合重建框架(Li等,2021;Guo等,2023;Liu等,2023;You等,2022)。 然而,这些方法往往对分配变化很敏感,可能在不同条件下难以概括。 虽然这些方法取得了强效,但它们也主要假定了单一观点的投入,并且没有明确利用分布于多种观点的补充证据。

blocks.en:
Reconstruction-based methods learn to restore normal images or features and detect anomalies based on reconstruction discrepancies.
DRAEM ( Zavrtanik et al., 2021 ) and NSA ( Schlüter et al., 2022 ) improve anomaly learning by introducing synthetic anomalies during training, while RealNet ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) further advances feature reconstruction with realistic synthetic anomalies and adaptive feature selection.
Other reconstruction-oriented methods ( Bergmann et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2021b ) , including RD4AD ( Deng and Li, 2022 ) , RD++ ( Tien et al., 2023b ) , and DeSTSeg ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) , reconstruct normal feature representations through reverse distillation and feature alignment between teacher and student networks.
Adversarial learning-based approaches have been introduced to improve reconstruction fidelity and better capture complex data distributions ( Schlegl et al., 2019 ; Akcay et al., 2018 ; Akçay et al., 2019 ) .
Memory-augmented reconstruction methods further constrain the model to represent normal patterns using a limited memory bank, alleviating over-generalization ( Gong et al., 2019 ; Park et al., 2020 ) .
More recently, diffusion-based generative models have been explored to achieve high-quality and robust reconstruction under complex data distributions ( Zhang et al., 2023a ; He et al., 2024 ) .
Despite these advances, reconstruction-based methods inherently suffer from a normality bias, where both normal and anomalous inputs are projected onto the learned normal manifold, often leading to limited anomaly sensitivity and degraded localization performance.
blocks.zh:
基于重建的方法学会了恢复正常的图像或特征并基于重建差异来检测异常.
DRAEM(Zavrtanik等,2021年)和NSA(Schlüter等,2022年)通过在训练期间引入合成异常来改进异常学习,而RealNet(Zhang等,2024年)的进一步进步则以现实合成异常和适应性特征选择为特征进行重建.
其他面向重建的方法(Bergmann等,2020;Wang等,2021b),包括RD4AD(Deng and Li,2022),RD++(Tien等,2023b)和DeSTSeg(Zhang等,2023b),通过倒向分解和师生网络的特征相接重建了正常的地物表现.
为提高重建忠心度和更好地捕捉复杂数据分布,引入了基于横向学习的方法(Schlegl等,2019;Akcay等,2018;Akçay等,2019)。
记忆增强重建方法进一步制约了模型使用有限的记忆库来代表正常模式,缓解了过度泛化(龚等,2019;朴等,2020.
最近,还探索了以传播为基础的基因模型,以便在复杂的数据分布下实现高质量和有力的重建(Zhang等人,2023a; He等, 2024 (英语).
尽管取得了这些进展,但基于重建的方法在本质上存在常态偏差,正常和异常的投入都投向了学到的常态多面,往往导致反常敏感度有限,本地化性能退化。

blocks.en: As a result, existing unsupervised anomaly detection methods are not well aligned with practical multi-view inspection settings, where complementary observations from different viewpoints must be jointly leveraged for reliable anomaly detection and localization.
blocks.zh: 因此,现有的不受监督的异常检测方法与实用多视图检查设置不完全一致,不同观点的补充观测必须联合利用,以便可靠地检测异常并本地化.

blocks.en: 2.2. Multi-view anomaly detection
blocks.zh: 2.2. 多视异常探测

blocks.en: Multi-view learning has been extensively studied in the broader computer vision community, particularly for tasks such as 3D reconstruction, object recognition, and cross-view representation learning, where complementary information from multiple viewpoints is leveraged to improve robustness and performance ( Su et al., 2015 ; Chen et al., 2017 ; Wang et al., 2021a ; Wang et al., 2022 ; Gordon et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Pang et al., 2023 ; Ma et al., 2022 ) . Building upon this foundation, multi-view anomaly detection extends conventional anomaly detection by exploiting multiple observations of the same object to enhance detection reliability and robustness. Unlike single-view approaches, where anomalies may be occluded or only partially visible, multi-view settings enable the aggregation of complementary evidence across views, thereby facilitating more accurate anomaly detection and localization.
blocks.zh: 多景学习在更广泛的计算机视觉界被广泛研究,特别是用于3D重建,对象识别等任务以及交叉视角代表学习,利用多观点的补充信息来提高稳健性和性能(Su等,2015;Chen等,2017;Wang等,2021a;Wang等,2022;Gordon等,2022;周等,2022;Pang等,2023;Ma等,2022). 在这个基础上,多视异常探测通过利用同一物体的多观测来扩大常规异常探测,以提高探测的可靠性和稳健性. 与单景法不同的是,反常现象可能被隐蔽或仅部分可见,多景法设置可以将各种观点的补充证据汇总起来,从而促进更准确的反常现象检测和本地化.

blocks.en:
Recent studies have explored various strategies to incorporate multi-view information into anomaly detection frameworks. MVAD ( He et al., 2026 ) proposes an adaptive selection-based attention mechanism that models semantic correlations across views by selecting top-k relevant regions for feature fusion. Multi-Flow ( Kruse and Rosenhahn, 2025 ) introduces a normalizing flow-based framework that enables cross-view information exchange through message passing and likelihood estimation across views.
In addition, alignment-based approaches have been investigated to enforce consistency across views. Epipolar-based methods ( Liu et al., 2025 ) utilize geometric constraints to establish correspondences along epipolar lines, while homography-based methods ( Chen et al., 2026 ) perform explicit feature alignment by projecting corresponding regions across views. These approaches aim to maintain spatial consistency and improve cross-view correspondence in anomaly detection tasks.
blocks.zh:
最近的研究探讨了将多视图信息纳入异常探测框架的各种战略。 MVAD(He等,2026年)提出适应性选择关注机制,通过选择顶端-克相关区域进行地物聚变,模拟不同观点的语义相关性. 多福(Kruse和Rosenhahn,2025年)引入了一个基于流动的正常化框架,通过传递消息和跨观点的可能性估计,可以进行跨视图信息交流。
此外,还调查了基于一致性的办法,以强化各种观点的一致性。 以Epipolar为基础的方法(Liu等,2025年)利用几何限制来按照地极线建立对应关系,而以homography为基础的方法(Chen等,2026年)则通过预测不同观点的相应区域来进行明确的特征对接. 这些方法的目的是在异常探测任务中保持空间一致性并改进交叉视图对应.

blocks.en: Remark. Despite these advances, effectively leveraging multi-view information for anomaly detection remains challenging. In particular, balancing cross-view interaction and view-specific representations entails an inherent trade-off: excessive information sharing weakens view-specific discriminative cues, while limited interaction hinders the integration of complementary multi-view evidence. Furthermore, while memory banks and normalizing flows have been adapted for multi-view settings, reconstruction-based paradigms remain largely underexplored. We conjecture this is primarily due to the difficulty of generating view-consistent pseudo-anomalies without disrupting the underlying geometric correlations across cameras. Designing an efficient framework that can simultaneously promote cross-view anomaly consistency while preserving view-aware structural reconstruction remains an open problem, which this work seeks to address.

blocks.en: 3.1. Perturbation and consensus aggregation
blocks.zh: 3.1. 干扰和共识汇总

blocks.en: A key challenge in extending reconstruction-based anomaly detection to the multi-view setting lies in generating view-aligned pseudo-anomalies. In single-view applications, local perturbations effectively force the model to learn normal structural restoration from corrupted inputs. However, directly applying this strategy to multi-view data is non-trivial. Because each view observes the object from a different angle, independent perturbations often introduce strong view-specific biases, resulting in isolated corruptions rather than a spatially coherent anomalous pattern. To address this, we introduce a consensus aggregation strategy: we first perturb the features of each view independently, and then aggregate them to construct highly aligned and cross-view coherent pseudo-anomaly representations.
blocks.zh: 将基于重建的异常探测扩展到多视图环境的关键挑战在于产生视界相通的假异常。 在单视图应用中,局部扰动有效迫使模型从被腐蚀的投入中学习正常的结构修复. 然而,将这一策略直接应用于多视图数据是非三角的. 由于每种观点都从不同的角度观察物体,独立的扰动往往会引入强烈的视点偏差,导致孤立的腐败,而不是空间上一致的异常模式. 为了解决这一问题,我们采用了协商一致的汇总战略:我们首先独立地探究每种观点的特点,然后将它们汇总起来,形成高度一致和交叉的一致的假异常表述。

blocks.en: By aggregating after perturbation, we essentially perform a latent-space consensus operation. While the injected noise is independent and stochastic for each view, the underlying structural features F i ( v ) F_{i}^{(v)} remain geometrically correlated across viewpoints. The aggregation module learns to suppress view-specific stochastic noise while emphasizing the shared structural manifold, thereby producing a pseudo-anomaly that resembles a coherent physical perturbation of the object rather than isolated sensor noise. As illustrated in Figure 3 , features generated independently for each view are widely scattered in the latent space, indicating view-biased anomaly representations. In contrast, after aggregation, the features become highly compact and are drawn closer to their shared centers. This confirms that our consensus aggregation strategy successfully constructs view-aligned anomaly representations that better reflect the coherent defect patterns encountered in real-world multi-view scenarios.

blocks.en:
We now describe our experimental setup and present both quantitative

blocks.en: 4.1. Experimental settings
blocks.zh: 4.1. 实验环境

blocks.en: Dataset. We evaluate on the Real-IAD ( Wang et al., 2024 ) dataset, which is a large-scale industrial anomaly detection dataset with multi-view observations over 30 object categories. Following the official split used in our experiments, the training set contains 36,465 normal images, while the test set contains 114,585 images, including 63,256 normal and 51,329 anomalous images.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们评价了Real-IAD(Wang等,2024年)数据集,这是一个大规模工业异常探测数据集,其多视图观测数据超过30个对象类别. 在我们实验中使用的官方分出后,训练集包含36,465个正常图像,而测试集包含114,585个图像,包括63,256个正常图像和51,329个异常图像.

blocks.en: Compared methods. We extensively evaluate our proposed framework against a diverse set of state-of-the-art unsupervised anomaly detection baselines. To ensure a comprehensive comparison, we include representation-based approaches (e.g., PatchCore ( Roth et al., 2022 ) , CFlow ( Gudovskiy et al., 2022 ) , and VSAD ( Chen et al., 2026 ) ) as well as reconstruction-based paradigms (e.g., DRAEM ( Zavrtanik et al., 2021 ) , DeSTSeg ( Zhang et al., 2023b ) , CKAAD ( Fang et al., 2025 ) , RD++ ( Tien et al., 2023b ) , and RealNet ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) ). Most importantly, we benchmark our approach against recent methods specifically tailored for multi-view anomaly detection, namely Multi-Flow ( Kruse and Rosenhahn, 2025 ) and MVAD ( He et al., 2026 ) , which represent the current state-of-the-art in this domain.
blocks.zh: 比较方法. 我们对照一套多样的、最先进的、不受监督的异常探测基线,广泛评估我们提议的框架。 为确保全面比较,我们包括基于代表性的方法(例如PatchCore(Roth等,2022年),CFlow(Gudovskiy等,2022年),VSAD(Chen等,2026年),以及基于重建的模式(例如DRAEM(Zavrtanik等,2021年),DeSTSeg(张等,2023年b),CKAAD(Fang等,2025年),RD++(Tien等,2023年b),和RealNet(Zhang等,2024年))。 最重要的是,我们参照最近专门为多视异常探测专门制定的方法,即多视异常(克鲁斯和罗森汉,2025年)和MVAD(He等,2026年),制定我们的方法基准,这些方法代表了该领域目前的先进水平。

blocks.en:
Evaluation metrics. We evaluate our method using sample-level AUROC (S-AUROC), image-level AUROC (I-AUROC), and pixel-level AUROC (P-AUROC). Specifically, S-AUROC evaluates anomaly detection performance at the multi-view sample level by aggregating view-wise scores, I-AUROC measures the ability to distinguish normal and anomalous images, and P-AUROC assesses the accuracy of pixel-wise anomaly localization.
Note that when an anomaly is visible only from a subset of sample images, then the sample is defined as anomalous while some individual images are labeled as “normal”.

评价尺度。 我们使用样品级AUROC(S-AUROC),图像级AUROC(I-AUROC)和像素级AUROC(P-AUROC)来评价我们的方法. 具体来说,S-AUROC通过汇总取景分数来评价多视图样本层的异常检测性能,I-AUROC测量正常和异常图像的分辨能力,而P-AUROC则评估了像素偏向异常本地化的精度.
请注意,当一个异常现象只从样本图像的子集中可见时,则该样本被定义为异常,而一些单个图像被标为"正常".

blocks.en: Implementation details. We use ViT-Base/14 pre-trained with DINOv2 as the encoder ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) . The perturbation module uses a dropout rate of 0.2, a feature jitter scale of 20.0, a jitter application probability of 1.0, and a random patch masking probability of 0.1. We optimize the network with StableAdamW ( Wortsman et al., 2023 ) with AMSGrad ( Reddi et al., 2018 ) and decoupled weight decay ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) , using a learning rate of 2 × 10 − 3 2\times 10^{-3} , β = ( 0.9 , 0.999 ) \beta=(0.9,0.999) , and weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} . The network is trained for 5,000 iterations on Real-IAD. All experiments are conducted on a server equipped with four NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs.

blocks.en: 4.2. Quantitative results
blocks.zh: 4.2. 量化结果

blocks.en:
Table 1 summarizes the quantitative results on Real-IAD. Our method achieves the best overall performance among all compared methods, obtaining 96.7% S-AUROC, 92.6% I-AUROC, and 99.1% P-AUROC on average. In particular, PAR improves the average S-AUROC to 96.7%, compared
with 95.9% for Multi-Flow and 94.3% for MVAD. It also achieves
92.6% I-AUROC and 99.1% P-AUROC, outperforming both prior
multi-view methods.
These results indicate that our perturb-aggregate-reconstruct framework more effectively leverages complementary multi-view information while preserving view-specific characteristics. The gains are especially meaningful at the sample and image levels, suggesting that our method produces more reliable anomaly evidence across views rather than relying on a shared reconstruction pathway.

blocks.en: 4.3. Qualitative results
blocks.zh: 4.3. 定性结果

blocks.en: Figure 6 presents qualitative comparisons with the state-of-the-art multi-view anomaly detection methods, Multi-Flow and MVAD. As shown in the examples, Multi-Flow often produces relatively weak or spatially diffuse responses around the defect regions, while MVAD tends to highlight broader background regions together with the anomalies, resulting in less precise localization. In contrast, our method generates compact and high-confidence anomaly maps that focus more accurately on the defective regions. Moreover, the localized anomaly regions produced by our method more closely resemble the ground-truth masks in both position and shape, demonstrating that PAR is better able to capture the actual extent of defects while suppressing irrelevant activations on normal regions.

Component ablation. We conduct component ablations to evaluate the effectiveness of consensus
aggregation, view-specialized decoding, and Fourier attention, as shown in
Table 2 . The baseline follows a standard
reconstruction-based framework, in which a pre-trained encoder extracts normal

perturbed features. Consensus aggregation substantially improves
performance by integrating the independently perturbed multi-view features
into more coherent pseudo-anomaly representations. The view-specialized
decoders enable the model to capture view-dependent characteristics that
are essential for multi-view anomaly detection. Fourier attention further
improves reconstruction by preventing trivial identity mapping and
promoting globally consistent structural recovery. Each component
contributes to the overall performance, and their combination yields the
best results, demonstrating their complementary effects.

Perturbation analysis. The impact of different pseudo-anomaly generation strategies is analyzed by applying dropout, feature jitter, and random masking to corrupt feature representations prior to multi-view fusion. Detailed results are provided in Table 3 .
Using a single perturbation provides limited improvement, whereas combining multiple perturbations consistently leads to better performance. In particular, applying all three perturbations achieves the best results, indicating that diverse feature corruption helps the model learn more discriminative anomaly representations.
All other components of the full model are retained while varying
only the perturbation operations.

blocks.en: Attention type analysis. Table 4 compares different attention mechanisms within the decoder. Softmax attention yields the lowest performance, while masked and linear attention substantially improve all three metrics, indicating that restricting direct spatial correspondence helps alleviate shortcut reconstruction. Fourier attention achieves the best results, slightly outperforming linear attention. These results support the effectiveness of frequency-domain filtering in promoting globally consistent reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 注意类型分析。 表4比较了解码器内部不同的关注机制. 软最大注意力产生最小性能,而蒙面和线性注意力则大大地改善了所有三个度量衡,表明限制直接的空间通信有助于减缓捷径重建. 傅里叶的注意能取得最佳效果,略高于线性注意. 这些成果支持了频率域过滤在促进全球连贯重建方面的效力。

blocks.en: Multi-decoder analysis. The effect of the proposed multi-decoder design is evaluated by comparing it with a single-decoder baseline, as reported in Table 5 . For a fair comparison, we also increase the capacity of the single-decoder baseline by using a larger MLP ratio and a deeper feed-forward network (FFN). Despite this, the proposed multi-decoder model consistently achieves the best performance across all metrics, obtaining 96.73 S-AUROC, 92.62 I-AUROC, and 99.12 P-AUROC. In contrast, simply increasing the capacity of a single shared decoder does not improve performance and even leads to slight degradation. These results suggest that the performance gain does not stem from larger model capacity, but from explicitly decomposing the reconstruction process into view-specialized pathways.
blocks.zh: 多解码器分析. 如表5所报告,通过将多解码器设计与单解码器基准进行比较,来评价拟议的多解码器设计的效果。 为了进行公平的比较,我们还利用更大的MLP比和更深的向导网络(FFN)来提高单解码器基线的容量. 尽管如此,拟议的多解码器模型始终实现所有衡量标准的最佳性能,获得了96.73 S-AUROC、92.62 I-AUROC和99.12 P-AUROC。 相形之下,仅仅提高单个共享解码器的容量并不能改善性能,甚至导致轻微退化. 这些结果表明,业绩收益并非来自更大的模型能力,而是来自将重建进程明确分解成有特色的路径。

Missing view evaluation. Table 6 evaluates the proposed method under
missing-view scenarios. We progressively remove input views at inference
time while keeping the model trained on full-view data. Compared with
Multi-Flow and MVAD, the proposed method achieves the best performance
for nearly all metrics and missing-view settings while remaining
competitive in the remaining case. Although performance generally
decreases as views are removed, PAR preserves its performance more
effectively than the competing methods. This robustness can be attributed in part to the view-specialized decoders, which preserve view-dependent normality patterns and reduce reliance on a single shared reconstruction pathway.

blocks.en: 5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we presented PAR, a novel reconstruction-based framework tailored for multi-view anomaly detection. Following a perturb-aggregate-reconstruct paradigm, our method first generates highly view-aligned pseudo-anomalies through stochastic feature perturbation and a late consensus aggregation module. These aligned representations are then processed by view-specialized decoders, which effectively increase the model’s representational complexity to preserve fine-grained, view-dependent normality patterns. Furthermore, we integrated Fourier attention into the decoders to shift the reconstruction process to the frequency domain, successfully preventing trivial identity mapping and ensuring robust, anomaly-free recovery. By jointly encouraging spatial coherence of pseudo-anomalies, improving view-specific normal-feature reconstruction and preventing identity mapping, PAR achieves improved multi-view anomaly detection performance over state-of-the-art methods on the large-scale Real-IAD benchmark.
blocks.zh: 在这份论文中,我们介绍了基于重建的新型框架PAR,这个框架适合多视图异常探测。 遵循一个扰动-凝聚-重建的范式,我们的方法首先通过斯多克特征扰动和晚共识聚合模块产生高度相通的取景相通的伪模拟. 这些对齐的表示然后由取景专业解码器处理,这有效地增加了模型的取景复杂性来保存精细的,取景依赖的常态模式. 此外,我们把Fourier的注意力纳入解码器,将重建过程转移到频率域,成功地防止了微不足道的身份映射,确保了稳健,无异常的恢复. PAR通过联合鼓励伪亚热带的空间一致性,改善视点特异性平面重建,并预防身份映射,实现了比大型Real-IAD基准上最先进的方法更好的多景异常探测性能.

blocks.en:
Limitations. Despite its strong performance, PAR has a few limitations. First, the framework assumes a fixed multi-view camera setup with dedicated decoder assignments, which may be less suitable for scenarios with varying or unordered viewpoints. Second, while our consensus aggregation strategy produces highly aligned pseudo-anomalies, it does not strictly enforce geometric consistency of pseudo-anomaly features.
Finally, scaling the number of decoders linearly with the number of views introduces additional memory overhead compared to a single shared decoder.
blocks.zh:
限制。 尽管PAR的性能很强,但有一些局限性. 首先,框架假设一个固定的多视图相机设置,并有专门的解码器任务,这可能不太适合有不同或无序观点的情景. 第二,虽然我们共识的汇总战略产生了高度一致的伪无常现象,但它并没有严格强制实施伪无常特征的几何一致性。
最后,用视图数量线性地将解码器数量缩放,比起单一共享解码器,引入了额外的内存管理.

blocks.en: Pre-trained backbone analysis. The quality of the frozen foundation encoder has a direct impact on unsupervised multi-view anomaly detection performance. To examine this effect, we compare several representative self-supervised backbones that are trained with different pre-training objectives, including masked image modeling (MIM), contrastive learning (CL), and their combination. D-iGPT ( Ren et al., 2023 ) is a pure MIM-based model, where the pretext task focuses on recovering target features from masked inputs. MoCo v3 ( Chen et al., 2021 ) represents a contrastive learning paradigm that learns discriminative representations by pulling semantically similar samples closer and pushing dissimilar ones apart. In contrast, iBOT ( Zhou et al., 2021 ) and DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) combine contrastive learning and masked image modeling, providing both discriminative and reconstruction-aware supervisory signals during pre-training. As shown in Table A1 , encoders trained with both CL and MIM generally provide stronger performance than those relying on a single objective, with DINOv2 achieving the best overall results. This suggests that jointly learning semantic discrimination and masked reconstruction yields feature representations that are more suitable for our reconstruction-based multi-view anomaly detection framework.

MoCo v3(Chen等,2021年)代表了一种对比性的学习范式,通过拉近相近的标本来学习有区别的表述,并推开相异的标本. 相形之下,iBOT(周克等,2021年)和DINOv2(Oquab等,2024年)结合了对比性学习和蒙面图像模型,在预训期间同时提供有区别和有再重建意识的监督信号. 如表A1所示,受过CL和MIM培训的编码器一般比依赖单一目标的编码器提供更强的性能,DINov2取得了最佳的总体结果. 这表明,共同学习语义上的歧视和蒙面重建的结果,是更适合我们基于重建的多视图异常探测框架的表述。

blocks.en: Aggregation strategy analysis. The effect of different aggregation strategies is summarized in Table A2 . Among the compared methods, the simple MLP layer consistently achieves the best performance across all three metrics, outperforming both MLP-Mixer ( Tolstikhin et al., 2021 ) and cross-attention ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) . blocks.en: To further examine the generalization ability of the proposed method, we conduct additional experiments on two large-scale multi-view anomaly detection datasets, namely M 2 AD and MANTA.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步审查拟议方法的一般化能力,我们对两个大型多视异常探测数据集,即M2 AD和MANTA进行更多的实验.

blocks.en: M 2 AD is a benchmark designed to evaluate visual anomaly detection under the complex interplay of viewpoint and illumination. It contains 119,880 high-resolution images collected from 999 specimens across 10 categories, where each specimen is captured under 12 synchronized views and 10 illumination settings, resulting in 120 imaging configurations per object. The dataset includes 69,070 normal images and 50,810 anomalous images with pixel-precise annotations, making it a challenging benchmark for multi-view anomaly detection under realistic imaging variations ( Cao et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 联合国 2 AD是一个基准,旨在评价在视角和发光的复杂相互作用下进行的视觉异常探测。 它包含从999个标本上收集到的119,880个高分辨率图像,分出10个类别,其中每个标本在12个同步视图和10个照明设置下被捕获,导致每个物体120个成像配置. 该数据集包括69,070个普通图像和50,810个带有像素精准说明的反常图像,使其成为现实成像变异下多景异常探测的挑战性基准(Cao等,2026年).

blocks.en: MANTA is a large-scale multi-view anomaly detection dataset for tiny industrial objects. Its visual component comprises more than 137.3K images across 38 product categories spanning five domains, among which about 8.6K anomalous images are provided with pixel-level annotations. Each object is captured from five distinct viewpoints, enabling comprehensive multi-view evaluation in fine-grained industrial inspection scenarios ( Fan et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: MANTA是小型工业物体的大型多视异常探测数据集. 其视觉部分由超过137.3K的图像组成,涵盖38个产品类别,涉及5个领域,其中约8.6K反常图像有像素级别的说明. 每个目标都从五个不同的角度来捕捉,从而能够在精细的工业检查情景中进行全面的多观点评价(Fan等,2025年)。
